concepts.name: Latch Nine
concepts.outcome: Show actual docking clearance; acknowledge repeat arrival; original docking survives tender loss
concepts.source_overlap_constraint: Extend dockingCorridor and stationBroadcast; do not replace their authority. BRACKET already occupies the funny yard-robot role, so Latch is a working harbor instrument, never a ball-game host. The earlier exploratory gantry image is not a shipping model.
acceptance_cases: Deny docking while an animation is opening: the UI and corridor still deny it.
Disable the character: every original docking route remains usable.
Ram from three bearings: the visible body and collision proxy agree.
Load after a completed arrival: no duplicate bark or reward.
Recognize HOLD and CLEAR with grayscale, sound muted, and reduced motion enabled.

concepts.name: Sable Venn & the Patchwork
concepts.outcome: Demonstrate isolated actual fits; compare/cancel/commit without live-state mutation
concepts.source_overlap_constraint: Reuse ships, buildIdentity, crafting and ORRERY. Sable offers diagnoses and demonstrations, not another fitting database or independent stat writer. Her workshop is not MORROW’s rescue automaton.
acceptance_cases: Preview ten modules and cancel: live fit, credits and RNG state remain byte-equivalent.
Commit after inventory changes: revalidation refuses the stale quote.
Compare displayed impulse and heat with measured values in the same preview configuration.
Open/close preview fifty times: no retained meshes, listeners or physics worlds.
Keyboard and controller can select, compare, confirm and return without a hover-only action.

concepts.name: Tally-3, Claim Assessor
concepts.outcome: Disclose owned/disputed/unclaimed evidence; deliver one actual crate exactly once
concepts.source_overlap_constraint: Extend salvage, claims and provenanceLedger. BRACKET sorts scrap into a sport; Tally examines legal claim evidence. Its weighing gesture is presentation, not a second economy algorithm.
acceptance_cases: Tow an owned crate without confirming: no sale occurs.
Replay the delivery collision ten times: one transfer and one payment.
Change claimant before confirming: the old offer invalidates.
Load with a tethered crate: body, owner and receiver still agree.
Destroy assessor: station fallback still resolves the contract.

concepts.name: Ilex Seed Ark
concepts.outcome: Six finite separable seed vaults; 0/1/5/6 delivered branches; later greenhouse consequence
concepts.source_overlap_constraint: Reuse escort missions, fragileCargo, traffic and cargo ownership. This is cultivated human seed stock, not a second alien infection, and not an extension of the Vethari mythology.
acceptance_cases: Sever a rotating pod: velocity matches the rigid-body point velocity.
Save during severance and reload: no duplicate capsule or lost mass.
Deliver 0,1,5,6 pods: all outcomes lead somewhere coherent.
Escort exits sector while player tows: route and destination remain resolvable.
One NPC damages a pod: provenance does not blame the player.

concepts.name: Red Kite
concepts.outcome: Optional force-driven ordered-gate relay; honest loss, interruption and persistent recognition
concepts.source_overlap_constraint: The repo already has nemesis, aceMemory and Orra. Red Kite does not learn a counter-build or occupy that arc. Reuse route following and stunt evidence; no new racing control scheme.
acceptance_cases: Run identical inputs at 30/60/144 render FPS: finish tick is equal.
Cross gate backward or twice: no illegitimate advancement.
Block a course with a heavy wreck: race aborts cleanly rather than teleporting.
Trigger combat on the last gate: no simultaneous win and refund.
Inspect a losing opponent: its thrust and speed stay within the same authored definition.

concepts.name: The Towline Table
concepts.outcome: Three distinct workers; actual claimed assistance and witnessed reciprocal obligations
concepts.source_overlap_constraint: A named occupational circle inside faction_free, not a new ninth political faction or separate reputation scale. Existing Morrow handles a singular rescue encounter; this crew coordinates several ordinary working ships and records reciprocal obligations.
acceptance_cases: Two helpers claim one job in the same tick: exactly one tow owner.
A job resolves before approach: tug releases the reservation and returns.
Kill a crew member and reload: identity remains absent and dialogue changes.
Request help without a free slot: explanation is truthful, with no phantom ship.
Repeat the same favor receipt: no accumulating free service.

concepts.name: Scissorwake
concepts.outcome: One line-cut specialist; committed swept pass, two physical counters, single detach
concepts.source_overlap_constraint: Not a replacement for tether_control_raider. The GDD explicitly protects ordinary Massline strength: a cut is a named engineered attack, never a silent tension nerf. First reuse any shipped cutter attack discovered during rebase; add its distinctive model and encounter before inventing a second kernel.
acceptance_cases: Move the line outside the swept corridor during windup: no cut.
Render at 15 FPS: damage/cut still occurs on the identical fixed tick.
Throw the cutter backward: it cannot cut a line it never intersects.
Release manually on the impact tick: exactly one detach, no exception.
Turn off effects/audio: shape and textual threat still expose the counterplay.

concepts.name: Kilnback
concepts.outcome: Capped-turn burn and finite detachable coolant casks; observed cover/cooling counterplay
concepts.source_overlap_constraint: Not the Mirrorjaw Foreman or Forge Regent: no reflective prow, no enlarged boss health bar. Reuse volatileExposure, fields and damage owners for a coolant/heat interaction, with a data-defined new recipe only where existing primitives cannot express it.
acceptance_cases: Disable VFX: the same field tests produce the same damage and cancellation.
Break cask during save/load boundary: only one field appears.
Hide behind authored cover: the jet respects the chosen occlusion contract.
Move cask after detachment: no remaining parent collider blocks it.
Provoke the first burn from every approach: warning always precedes damage.

concepts.name: Pallet Jack
concepts.outcome: Staged visible lift-and-escape of the same cargo; contested tow, drop/parley/recovery
concepts.source_overlap_constraint: Mine-Layer Jackal already prefers cargo/wreck claims. Pallet Jack must add the actual staged lift-and-escape interaction and broad physical fork silhouette; do not merely duplicate that preference in a new stats row.
acceptance_cases: Move the pallet during grab: clamp misses honestly.
Destroy thief carrying cargo: one surviving pallet, no duplicate loot item.
Contest with Massline: established attachment arbitration stays deterministic.
Cross-sector escape and reload: exactly the same cargo provenance returns.
No eligible cargo: no useless thief spawn.

concepts.name: Mothlight
concepts.outcome: Visible real shutter plus finite physical decoys; no spoofed critical UI or invisible attacker
concepts.source_overlap_constraint: Quiet Ghost already supplies stealthy ranged repositioning. Mothlight is a visible decoy-deploying tender, never cloaked and never an omniscient sniper. Its decoys are real destructible entities with cheap behavior.
acceptance_cases: No scanner or audio: player can still distinguish real shutter geometry.
Kill all lamps and reload: stock does not replenish.
Change render FPS: local sequence and attack tick stay equal.
Push a lamp: it drifts physically rather than snapping back.
Hide the actual weapon behind cover: its shot respects occlusion.

concepts.name: Tethys Switchyard
concepts.outcome: Three receivers, one gantry, finite jobs; physical jam, truthful restart and usable bypass
concepts.source_overlap_constraint: Reuse npcJobsRuntime, environmentalMachinery and actual cargo transfers. No decorative orbiting traffic, no substitute route engine, and no new magnetic force law when the existing field machinery suffices.
acceptance_cases: Add zone in nonzero-origin sector: atlas position round-trips exactly.
Jam gantry with a player ship: machinery stops, never tunnels.
Resolve cargo by another route: waiting job updates instead of hanging.
Save a reserved berth: one reservation and one cargo survive.
Destroy yard: bypass is usable and no credits/stock are fabricated.

concepts.name: The Borrowed Sun
concepts.outcome: Scheduled visiting market, fixed safe berth first; actual services and safe closing
concepts.source_overlap_constraint: Use existing market, traffic, station services and ORRERY. Not a replacement station shell or a new pricing algorithm. Visit schedule is simulated and inspectable, never real-world FOMO or a daily-login timer.
acceptance_cases: Buy on closing tick: exactly one accepted transaction or one clear denial.
Remain docked past planned departure: no forced teleport or lost ship.
Restart app after a long wall-clock gap: visit changes only under intended sim/offline rules.
Remove GLB from test server: chart and fallback service remain usable.
Inspect folded and open colliders: no invisible petal walls.

concepts.name: The Thimble Door
concepts.outcome: True compound-collider opening, hull-and-tow clearance, camera-safe bypass and recorder
concepts.source_overlap_constraint: Existing places and physics already support obstacles. This is a deliberately authored alternate route, not a new traversal system. Do not release it until camera clipping and corridor collision tests pass.
acceptance_cases: Sweep smallest and largest hulls across all rim directions: contacts match visible ribs.
Tow a wide crate through and around: no false CLEAR result.
Place camera inside every rim quadrant: player and exit remain legible.
Save while partly inside: reload never ejects or duplicates bodies.
Recover recorder after an interrupted attempt: objective remains reachable.

concepts.name: Anvil Storm Orchard
concepts.outcome: Three finite harvest pods and readable local forecast through current field owner
concepts.source_overlap_constraint: Extend zone_tethys_anvil, planets and planetRuntime. Do not add a second planet with identical sling/skim behavior, and never change the canonical planet field just to fit this content.
acceptance_cases: Compare forecast direction with applied force at multiple points.
Load one tick before gust: full remaining warning is truthful.
Harvest the same pod twice: second request refuses.
Leave and return midcycle: resource and phase do not reset for profit.
Maximal tow length and large hull: safe pocket actually remains safe.

concepts.name: Veil-Ray Nursery
concepts.outcome: Existing veil_ray noncombat stimulus response; three adults and aggregate juveniles
concepts.source_overlap_constraint: Use existing veil_ray species and its sensitivity to scans/weapons. Do not invent another parasite, retcon Vethari canon, or turn these fauna into tactical enemies. Cinder Nursery already exists; this is a small satellite encounter, not a replacement biome.
acceptance_cases: Active scan disperses formation through existing stimulus rules.
Passive observation succeeds without hidden input sequence.
Mute sound and reduce motion: behavior and survey cues still understandable.
Exit/reenter repeatedly: no population or survey-reward duplication.
Use maximum graphics quality: juvenile aggregation does not create dozens of AI updates.

concepts.name: Borrowed Voice
concepts.outcome: Three recoverable signal sources; gated evidence, partial knowledge and actual disposition
concepts.source_overlap_constraint: Keep the Vethari → fungus → host/ecology → shared-memory chain. Understory remains the technical namespace. This is damaged retained signal, not proof the hive has a human personality, not a new species and not the off-frame creators appearing as an NPC.
acceptance_cases: Before revelation gate: no captions or journal titles spoil readable content.
Move recorder through the threshold repeatedly: one fragment and one reward.
Destroy one source: partial conclusion and journal remain valid.
Render-only animation changes: signal score is unchanged.
Reload after quarantine: no restored emission or new biology spawn.

concepts.name: The Open-Hand Lock
concepts.outcome: Actual courier token accepted by protocol; safe swept gate, refusal and outer bypass
concepts.source_overlap_constraint: Use existing auditor, courier and conservator roles, and protocol states—not faction reputation. No mystical riddle machine, no new precursor race, no revelation of the creators.
acceptance_cases: Present wrong token-shaped object: no access.
Occupy gate at closure: collider waits safely.
Retain token: outside route and main story remain valid.
Load mid-open: same protocol and safe gate state return.
Before the applicable revelation: machine behavior stays within current canon gates.

concepts.name: The Last Shift
concepts.outcome: Three physical clues, six discovery orders, truthful partial archive and finite salvage
concepts.source_overlap_constraint: Reuse aftermathWrecks, uniqueWrecks, salvage and the chronicler/provenance ledger. This is authored evidence for those owners, not a new universal story engine or omniscient replay system.
acceptance_cases: Recover clues in all six orders: final evidence set agrees.
Destroy each clue separately: partial report remains truthful and accessible.
Publish twice: only one archive receipt per evidence revision.
Scan a towed recorder: no identity loss or duplicate object.
Turn off reconstruction: all essential information remains in accessible journal text.

concepts.name: Pip & Spanner
concepts.outcome: One pre-run purchase plus one milestone repair; readable item/cost/mount and exact receipt
concepts.source_overlap_constraint: Compose the existing ORRERY UI, survivalDraft, swarmSupply and runSession. No second inventory, no campaign leakage, no independent frontend redesign. Crew choreography decorates a truthful transaction; it never decides the result.
acceptance_cases: Double-confirm one offer: one debit and one item.
Close/reopen at every transaction state: displayed build equals authoritative run build.
Fail the GLB load: SVG and text allow full selection and launch.
Keyboard/gamepad-only walk reaches every option, compare, back and launch.
Finish or abort run: zero unintended change to campaign credits, inventory or kills.

concepts.name: The Hundred-Hand Mile
concepts.outcome: Five finite receipt-backed chapters; partial/restitution branches and real final convoy
concepts.source_overlap_constraint: Compose existing mission/story/provenance/chronicler systems and concepts 3,4,6,11,18. This is not a second campaign spine or a universal procedural story generator. Keep the main story intact.
acceptance_cases: Complete milestones in permitted alternate orders: graph reaches coherent branch.
Lose Ilex cargo or a Last Shift clue: partial branch still completes.
Install while another ship occupies the volume: action waits or denies safely.
Replay all receipts after save/load: no duplicate modules or payments.
Destroy and rebuild: costs/rewards conserve the intended resource budget.
